result_family: Euclidean Kakeya/Nikodym consequences and local Riemannian geodesic-tube estimates

source_files.geometry: Euclidean R^n unit-segment tubes and Euclidean volume
Local smooth Riemannian manifold patch, using a local Beltrami chart, the Riemannian bundle, local metric distortion and Riemannian volume
Actual fixed-length local Riemannian geodesic images and Hausdorff-dimension conclusion inside a compact chart patch
Constructs local chart/tube patches and establishes the stated local geodesic-Nikodym estimate/dimension conclusions when the abstract chart metric has constant sectional curvature

correspondence_and_scope.formal_geodesic_tubes: The formalization concerns genuine fixed-length geodesic images inside smooth Riemannian manifolds, with local chart and metric-volume comparison conditions.
correspondence_and_scope.euclidean_dependency: The manifold maximal estimate transfers a Euclidean Nikodym maximal bound through a local Beltrami chart using controlled forward/inverse Lipschitz and volume comparison.
correspondence_and_scope.constant_curvature_scope: The literal existence theorem constructs the required chart/tube patch under a constant-sectional-curvature hypothesis on the abstract chart metric.
correspondence_and_scope.theorem_boundary: This is not a result for arbitrary Lorentzian manifolds, Kerr spacetime, null geodesic congruences, or relativistic optical Jacobi maps.
correspondence_and_scope.no_transfer_claim: No Euclidean/Riemannian local-smoothing or Nikodym estimate is asserted for Kerr. Any application to black-hole null rays is a separate conjecture/benchmark requiring its own analytic hypotheses and independent numerical tests.

relevance_to_luminous.symthaea: A formal-method source for reasoning about geodesic-tube concentration, chart distortion and assumption matching. Symthaea must classify the geometric signature and theorem hypotheses before proposing reuse.
relevance_to_luminous.symtropy: Motivates a new caustic-aware Kerr ray-bundle benchmark, but does not prove its convergence or stability estimates.
relevance_to_luminous.sol_atlas: Supports explicit chart, metric, tube and coordinate-provenance fields in a geodesic/caustic projection; does not authorize interpreting renderings as measurements.
relevance_to_luminous.mycelix: Record the Euclidean theorem, Riemannian theorem, numerical Kerr experiment and any future Lorentzian theorem as distinct evidence objects.
